name: terminal-browser-ssh
description: Opens terminal-browser in a pane inside Claude Code, including over SSH: frames go as PNG when the terminal cannot read this machine's shared memory, and the browser gets a virtual display on servers without one. Fork of the zenbu-labs terminal-browser plugin 0.0.2.

agentTool.title: Give the agent a tool to open/close terminal-browser inside claude code
agentTool.description: Adds an open/close tool the model can call to show a page in the browser pane. Off by default.
